title: Október 6. és Június 4.: Vértanúk és Összetartozás (October 6 & June 4: Martyrs & National Cohesion)
grammar: Commemorative Syntax, State Protocol & Solemn Historical Memorialization

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say whom the nation remembers on October 6 and what June 4 is the day of.
I can name the Martyrs of Arad and Count Lajos Batthyány.
I can use phrases of solemn remembrance such as fejet hajt and koszorút helyez el.
I can read a short text about the remembrance days and answer questions about it.
